```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

COVID <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(COVID))

rlang::last_trace()
```

```{r}
ggplot(COVID, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Number of Cases") +
  ylab("Year") +
  ggtitle("Number of COVID cases per year")

```
